items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: He was one the great -- he used to work with Benny Carter, and he worked with Quincy Jones' band.

ctx.x: I didn't know him, but I've heard him play.
He was one the great -- he used to work with Benny Carter, and he worked with Quincy Jones' band.
He worked a short while with Ellington, too.
